description.value: A fine linen tapestry depicting monks sparring in a courtyard... is rolled up and leans against the wall—

items.name: A set of solid silver idols

description.value: They depict a wyvern with a human rider, a human warrior trampling a demon underfoot, a centaur dressed in plate mail armor, and a leaping fish with a wide mouth filled with teeth
This idol depicts a wizard from Thassilonian times.
